subject: Data residency & deletion evidence request — Acme Financial SOC2/ISO
messages:
From: Jill Terrell <jill.terrell@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendor Audit <vendor-audit@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: data residency & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 and ISO readiness assessment we need a concise package of evidence around your retention and deletion controls. Specifically we need: 
- The current written retention policy describing ranges by data type and residency constraints.
- Evidence of deletions (audit logs or runbook outputs) for customer data upon request and scheduled purges for stale data.
- Controls around backups and geographic residency (where backups are stored and how deletion is propagated).
- A short narrative of how retention/deletion is validated during an audit (who performs it, tooling, sampling approach).

I attached a short checklist (Acme_Request_Shortlist.xlsx) with line items — if you can return evidence for the highlighted items by EOD Friday 20 Feb that would help keep our timeline. Let me know if you need more time.

Regards,
Jill Terrell
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Acme Financial

Attachments: Acme_Request_Shortlist.xlsx (excel, 12KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Terrell <jill.terrell@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vendor Audit <vendor-audit@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: data residency & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Jill — thanks for the checklist. We're on it.

Quick internal note for Rishi and Neha (looping you in): can each of you confirm which artifacts you can own for this request? Our plan: 
- Rishi, legal/compliance: comment on retention policy language and audit narrative.
- Neha, engineering: produce deletion/audit logs, backup residency notes, and a short runbook.

Target: compile a single zip with the policy and supporting evidence and a 1-page narrative by end-of-day Friday (20 Feb). If anything will slip, flag now.

Jill — we'll deliver via a shared Drive link and mark anything redacted as necessary.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: data residency & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Marissa — I can take ownership of the policy doc and audit narrative. A few legal points for the response: 
1) Retention windows are contract-driven; our public policy lists defaults for logs, ephemeral caches, user content, and backups. We should avoid committing to any residency guarantees beyond what is in customer contracts.
2) For deletion evidence, we can provide sanitized audit logs showing deletion job runs and samples of object lifecycle events. Avoid including PII in logs — we'll provide redacted exports.
3) If Acme needs full deletion proof for a specific dataset, that requires a scoped request and possibly customer-side verification per our Data Processing Addendum.

I'll prepare RetentionPolicy_v2.pdf with tracked changes and a 1-page narrative that maps each checklist item to artifacts.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: data residency & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Marissa / Rishi — attaching artifacts I put together:
- Deletion_Runbook.md (runbook describing on-demand and scheduled deletion flows).
- SOC2_Retention_Evidence.zip (contains: s3_lifecycle_events_sample.csv, db_soft_delete_audit.jsonl.redacted, backup_location_matrix.csv).

Notes / highlights:
- Backups: daily snapshots are replicated across two AWS regions (us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 replica) for durability. Snapshots are retained for 90 days in primary, 180 days in replica for disaster-recovery; deletion of customer data is propagated via lifecycle jobs that mark objects for purge; we include verification markers in the deletion job logs.
- Deletion evidence: I've exported a sampled set of lifecycle events (s3_lifecycle_events_sample.csv) and our job run logs for the past 6 months showing purges. All PII was redacted per Rishi's guidance.
- Tooling: deletion jobs are orchestrated via our internal scheduler and logged centrally in ELK; runbook includes links to job ids and sample curl commands for verification.

I expect to drop the packaged zip in the shared Drive by EOD today.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Staff Software Engineer, Storage Platforms
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Deletion_Runbook.md (text, 6KB), SOC2_Retention_Evidence.zip (zip, 2.1MB)

Subject: Re: Evidence request: data residency & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Jill — thanks for the patience. Per your checklist we prepared a consolidated package and uploaded it to a shared Drive folder (link below). Highlights: 

- RetentionPolicy_v2.pdf — updated policy with retention windows by data class (logs, user content, caches, backups) and a short section on contractual variances. (owner: Rishi)
- SOC2_Retention_Evidence.zip — sampled, redacted audit exports demonstrating scheduled purges and on-demand deletion job IDs across the last 6 months. (owner: Neha)
- Deletion_Runbook.md — runbook describing the end-to-end deletion workflow, verification steps, and escalation path.
- 1-page narrative mapping (evidence_mapping.txt) that ties each checklist row to deliverables.

Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/retention-evidence-acme 
If you want a short walkthrough call to review the artifacts and point to where each checklist item is satisfied we can schedule 30 minutes Monday morning.

One note: per our Data Processing Addendum we redact PII in exported logs. If Acme requires raw, unredacted artifacts for a scoped audit, please confirm the request and we will coordinate a formal, narrow exception with your security team.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
